name: US inventory categories and the account each change is booked to

data.comment: The counterpart of de-vorraete, and the contrast is the point of shipping both. Germany splits the change across two income-statement lines — its own position for finished and unfinished goods (§ 275 Abs. 2 Nr. 2), a correction of material expense for raw materials and merchandise. A US income statement has no such line: every change in inventory adjusts cost of goods sold, so all four categories name the same counter-account. The engine does not know the difference and does not need to; the same books, the same operation, two statements, and the whole of the difference is these four rows.
